modal.title: Import Journal
modal.description: Import entries from a backup or a folder of notes.

format.dayone_zip_caveat: Supports Day One JSON exports only. In Day One: File → Export → JSON.
format.journey_zip_caveat: Supports Journey v2 ZIP exports. In Journey: Settings → Export.
format.apple_journal_folder_caveat: Choose the exported folder — usually named AppleJournalEntries — that contains index.html, Entries, and Resources.

apple.import_notes: Apple Journal exports have a calendar date but no original time. Entries are stored as noon in {{timezone}}. Import only merges into the selected journal.
apple.need_preview: Review the folder before importing. Changing the folder clears the review.

warning.preserved_only: {{count}} preserved as source only (not fully converted)
warning.exceeds_video_upload_limit: {{count}} over the video upload limit (imported locally)
warning.exceeds_photo_upload_limit: {{count}} over the photo upload limit (imported locally)
warning.unsupported_visual_styling: {{count}} with unsupported visual styling (font colour is preserved-only)
warning.missing_source_time_zone: {{count}} missing a source time or timezone
warning.missing_live_photo_motion: {{count}} missing Live Photo motion (still image kept)
warning.unknown_metadata_or_cards: {{count}} with unknown metadata or cards (kept as provenance)
warning.media_upload_constraint: {{count}} over a media upload limit (imported locally)

apple.result_not_fully_converted: Preserved-only items are retained as provenance. They are not fully converted.
apple.native_metadata: Native metadata: title, body, calendar date, primary location, tags, and favorite.
apple.provenance_metadata: Retained as provenance only: font colour, source HTML, sidecars, extra visits, and resource hashes.
apple.synthetic_clock: The stored clock is synthetic local noon in {{timezone}}. The export has no original entry time or timezone.
apple.report_privacy: This report does not include journal text, filenames, coordinates, or media.
apple.save_report_body: Choose a file location outside the source folder. The original export folder is left untouched.
apple.save_report_inside_source: Choose a location outside the source folder. The export is not modified.

confirm.replace_body: This permanently deletes every entry, tag and media attachment currently in your journal. Type DELETE to confirm.
